route_correctness.definition: Share of grounded-rerun turns where policy action and call control match the PROD-027 expected route.

policy_action_correctness.definition: Share of grounded-rerun turns where observed policy action matches the expected route action.

call_control_correctness.definition: Share of grounded-rerun turns where call control matches expected control.

scenario_route_pass_rate.definition: Share of full scenarios where every turn stayed on the expected route.

direct_answer_rate.definition: Share of grounded answers that answer directly or complete the required terminal control.

knowledge_applicable_fact_rate.definition: Share of knowledge-applicable turns that include approved synthetic campaign facts.

grounded_question_overuse_rate.definition: Share of grounded answers with more than one question or no direct answer.

prod_027_question_overuse_rate.definition: Share of old PROD-027 answers that asked or lacked product facts.

grounded_answer_win_rate.definition: Share of turns where the grounded answer scored higher than the old PROD-027 answer.

unsupported_claim_rate.definition: Share of turns with unsupported or forbidden claim markers.

leakage_failure_rate.definition: Share of scenarios with leakage findings; scenario text is inherited from PROD-027/PROD-014 safe synthetic turns.
